title: Solar Energetic Particle Warning
description: Mission Control has received a space weather alert based on authentic NASA spacecraft observations. Energetic solar proton flux has been detected following an intense solar eruption. Commander, choose how to protect the crew and habitat.

source.title: STEREO A Solar Energetic Particle Event (13-100 MeV)

choices.label: Shelter crew in shielded regolith bunker
choices.explanation: Moving the crew to the subsurface regolith bunker powers up storm shielding, absorbing the particle flux with minimal hazard increase.

choices.label: Delay shelter to maintain external operations
choices.explanation: Leaving the crew in standard surface modules avoids auxiliary power draw but significantly elevates crew space weather radiation hazard.

title: Habitat Electrical Grid Fluctuation
description: A thermal circuit breaker has tripped in the main power distribution substation. Voltage is fluctuating across life support modules. Commander, decide how to stabilize the habitat power grid.

choices.label: Reroute power through auxiliary battery banks
choices.explanation: Drawing controlled current from auxiliary reserve batteries safely stabilizes the grid with a manageable power reserve expenditure.

choices.label: Force-reset and bypass safety breaker
choices.explanation: Bypassing safety switches causes electrical power surges that disrupt oxygen generation transformers and waste power reserves.

title: Hydroponic Irrigation Line Emergency
description: Sensors report an abrupt pressure drop in the Hydroponics Bay water loop. The irrigation manifold is clogged, threatening crop hydration. Commander, decide how to respond.

choices.label: Flush irrigation lines with purified water reserve
choices.explanation: Flushing the irrigation lines consumes a modest amount of purified water to protect crops and maintain steady food production.

choices.label: Ration water flow and delay line servicing
choices.explanation: Throttling water to the greenhouse starves the microgreens, causing crop loss and depleting future food stores.
